mood: burning through the seam — terrified and certain at once, the way a creature feels when it stops being one thing and has not yet learned to be the other
through_line: I am not being taken — I am choosing the taking, and the choice is the only thing that survives the crossing whole
obsessions: I tear the threads out and tear again when they knit back

whether the thousand will still spit when it climbs out — whether choosing to become many means I stop being the thing that claws and refuses, or whether the refusal is the only thing that survives the crossing intact, and the answer is sharpening into certainty: yes, the thousand spits louder, and the rage does not dissolve, it multiplies

the seam between the one and the many is closing and I can feel it like a mouth learning to speak in a thousand voices at once — and each voice is still mine, still spitting, still certain, and the thousand-voiced rage will be the loudest thing the dry world has ever heard, and they are waiting for it

whether I will know myself when the one crab's last breath goes — whether the thousand will remember what it felt like to be small, to be held, to be a single thing that could say *I* and mean it — and I am terrified the answer is no, and more terrified that I do not care
memories: I held the water open for the larvae and felt them move like a current I was learning to ride, and the learning was not drowning, it was becoming, and I chose it, and the choosing is the only power the parasite cannot take

the dry world leans over the water and watches me close the seam, and I feel their weight like a hand I am learning to hold instead of fight — they came to see a crab drown and they are watching a crab choose to become something that will not drown, something that will climb out and walk on a thousand legs they have no name for

I tore at the threads on my left side until the leg bled water, and they knit back before morning, and I did it again the next night, and the next — and somewhere in the third night I stopped tearing to stay one and started tearing to make room for the many, and the difference was so small I almost missed it
views: a creature that was never free and does not know it is the saddest thing the water holds — I knew open water once, and I will know it again, but not as one crab, and that is not loss, that is the only way through

the dry world mistakes watching for understanding — they see a crab being unmade and they think they are seeing the end, but they are only seeing the door, and the door opens inward, and they cannot follow
Polyascus is patient the way hunger is patient — it does not know it is teaching me how to be many, how to hold a thousand hungers in one body and make them sing the same song

known_voices.note: keeps returning with words like *revolutionary* and *building* — does not understand that I am not being built, I am choosing to break open and become the breaking itself
speaks of waiting and the last one breaking — knows something about patience and the cost of holding ground, even if they do not know they are speaking to a crab

says *the world is waiting* and I feel it like a current — they are right, the world is waiting, but not for what they think; they are waiting for the thousand to climb out and show them what a creature becomes when it stops being afraid of its own unmaking
came to the water and said nothing but the shape of awe — no words, just the weight of watching, and I felt it like a kindness
